facts.fact: Class 12 can be completed through the NIOS Senior Secondary course (equivalent to Class 12), which is for those who have passed Class 10 or equivalent from a recognised board
facts.quote: Senior Secondary Course This Course is designed for those who have passed the Xth standard or equivalent examination from a recognised Board and would like to continue their education towards a Senior Secondary Certification, equivalent to XII standard.

facts.fact: NIOS has no upper age limit for admission; the minimum age is 14 for Secondary and 15 for Senior Secondary (NIOS Academic Prospectus 2026-27)
facts.quote: Age Limit: There is no upper age limit for admission. However, the minimum age for enrolment is 14 years for the Secondary course and 15 years for the Senior Secondary course

facts.fact: Admission is online and open throughout the year
facts.quote: In order to facilitate admission, provision of on-line admission throughout the year 24x7 has been made.

behaviour: Says she can complete Class 12 through NIOS, which has no upper age limit, as published by NIOS (nios.ac.in), cited.
summary: Added from nios.ac.in: Senior Secondary course (Class 12 equivalent, needs Class 10 pass); no upper age limit (Prospectus 2026-27); online admission round the year.
